title: Brooklyn Bridge Dumbo Walking Tour with Photography Experience
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the iconic Brooklyn Bridge and Dumbo area on a unique walking tour that combines sightseeing with photography. Enjoy an engaging experience in small groups of up to six, led by a knowledgeable guide and photographer. Capture your adventures with five high-definition, edited photos while discovering fun facts about the neighborhood. Stroll from Jane's Carousel through Dumbo, ending at the breathtaking Brooklyn Bridge, all in about 1 to 1.5 hours. For those wanting more, additional photos can be purchased, and private group options are available for a more personalized experience.

- Small group tours for an intimate experience (1-6 participants)
- Includes 3 high-definition edited photos and candid shots
- Explore Dumbo and Brooklyn Bridge in about 1 to 1.5 hours
- Private group option available for up to 6 people with 100 total pictures
